    SELECT f."School Type",
           COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School) AS "School Name",
           s.Latitude
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

    SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
    FROM california_schools
    WHERE "School Type" IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
       OR (' ' || lower("School Name") || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z]middle[^a-z]*'
       OR (' ' || lower("School Name") || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z]intermediate[^a-z]*'
       OR (' ' || lower("School Name") || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z]junior[ -]high[^a-z]*'
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools)
ORDER BY "School Name", "School Type";

WITH school_rates AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.Charter, s.GSserved,
           1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND (TRIM(s.GSserved) = '12' OR TRIM(s.GSserved) LIKE '%-12')
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
), highest_rate_schools AS (
    SELECT r.School, r.Charter, r.GSserved, r.free_meal_rate,
           t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM school_rates AS r
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = r.CDSCode
    WHERE r.free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM school_rates)
)
SELECT School AS school_name,
       ROUND(free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
       CASE Charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
       GSserved AS grades_served,
       CASE
           WHEN sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
           WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
           WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance_level
FROM highest_rate_schools
ORDER BY school_name;
```

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    SELECT '2010-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
), monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM months AS m
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS l
        ON l.CreationDate >= m.month_start
       AND l.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
    LEFT JOIN posts AS p
        ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
       AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(post_count), 2) AS average_monthly_post_count
FROM monthly_counts;
```

    SELECT ID, TRIM("U-PRO") AS result
    FROM Laboratory
), urine_concentrations AS (
    SELECT ID,
           CASE
               WHEN result LIKE '>=%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(result, 3))
               WHEN result GLOB '+[0-9](*)' THEN
                   TRIM(SUBSTR(result, INSTR(result, '(') + 1,
                               LENGTH(result) - INSTR(result, '(') - 1))
               ELSE result
           END AS mg_dl
    FROM urine_results
)

FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (

    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM urine_concentrations AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID
      AND u.mg_dl NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
      AND u.mg_dl NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
      AND CAST(u.mg_dl AS REAL) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p.ID;
